speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these red bumps and whether the itching is worse at night? Also, have you noticed any burrows or burr-like lines on your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies. Given the intense itching, red bumps, recent travel to a conference setting, and the specific nature of your symptoms, I suspect a mite infestation. Has anyone in your household or close contacts experienced similar itching or skin changes recently?
